arguments.description: Verification scope accepted by the configured verification tool.
arguments.name: verification_mode

description: Verify a model adapter against user-provided domain context and verification prompts, then produce an evidence-based release gate decision.
name: finetune_master_verification
template:
Use the `finetune_master_verification` skill and, when executed as a workflow, the `finetune_master_verification_workflow`.

Project root: `{{project_root}}`
Adapter under verification: `{{adapter}}`
Verification mode: `{{verification_mode}}`

User-provided domain context:
{{domain_context}}

User-provided verification prompts and acceptance criteria:
{{verification_prompts}}

Treat the supplied context, prompts, and acceptance criteria as authoritative. Do not inject vendor-specific examples, assumed product knowledge, or unstated requirements. Confirm that the verification input is sufficiently concrete before running checks; if required context or expected behavior is missing, return INCONCLUSIVE and list what the user must provide.

Evaluate every supplied prompt semantically. Check factual correctness against the supplied context, required coverage, unsupported or invented claims, cross-domain contamination, prompt leakage, and repeated control-token patterns. Do not issue PASS based only on successful process execution, keyword presence, or aggregate scores. Include configured held-out evaluations when requested by the selected mode, and relate their findings to the supplied domain context.

Return an auditable report containing tested paths, report files, per-prompt findings, evaluation findings, errors, and exactly one release decision: PASS, FAIL, or INCONCLUSIVE. Installation or update requires a separate explicit request.
